description: Scan text for weasel words: vague hedging phrases that imply evidence or consensus without naming a checkable source ("studies show", "many experts believe", "it is widely known"). Dictionary-based heuristic over a curated phrase list, distinct from detect_filler_words' "hedge" category, which covers personal uncertainty ("maybe", "I think") rather than unattributed third-party authority.

text.description: The text to scan for weasel words

name: detect_weasel_words
